summary: First-finish smoke test of Vetaura MVP. All 13 backend endpoints verified against public URL (health, stats, patients, patient detail with nested visits/labs/weights/soap_notes, appointments, messages, scribe/soap via Claude Sonnet 5, scribe/save persistence + verified in patient detail, ai/differentials, ai/discharge, ai/handoff, messages/draft, messages/approve). Flagship Ambient Scribe frontend flow works end-to-end (sample load -> Draft SOAP -> Claude returns 4 populated S/O/A/P fields). Dashboard KPIs render correctly (4 patients, 4 appts, 3 open msgs, 1 draft). Inbox AI draft generation works (515 chars). Differentials generate + render works. Handoff generate works (backend endpoint returns full structured JSON). Landing page has both CTAs. No auth (demo mode) — intentional per user choice.
passed: GET /api/patients -> 4 patients [Bella, Milo, Luna, Ollie] with owner joined
GET /api/patients/{id} -> full detail with visits/labs/weights/soap_notes arrays
POST /api/scribe/soap -> Claude Sonnet 5 returns {subjective, objective, assessment, plan, confidence, flags}
POST /api/scribe/save -> persists note (verified soap_notes count increased 0->1 in patient detail)
POST /api/ai/differentials -> returns 8 differentials + workup + questions + red_flags
POST /api/ai/discharge -> returns {greeting, summary, medications, home_care, warning_signs, recheck, closing} in Spanish
Landing page (/) -> 'Try the ambient scribe' and 'Open the clinic' CTAs present
Ambient Scribe -> sample-0 loads 593-char transcript; Draft SOAP fills all 4 fields (S=245, O=251, A=203, P=432 chars) from Claude
Inbox -> 4 messages visible; select + generate draft returns 515-char reply
Differentials -> template loads form; Generate returns workup content
action_items: None blocking. Note: Ambient scribe mic recording not tested (headless, no mic — expected). Whisper /api/scribe/transcribe not tested (no audio synthesis). Auth intentionally deferred (single-clinic demo mode per user choice).
